name: McGregor Memorial EMS
use: Headquarters and ambulance bays of McGregor Memorial EMS, the largely volunteer, student-heavy ambulance service for Durham, Lee, Madbury and UNH
statusNote: Leased from UNH by McGregor Memorial EMS

facts.text: Founded in 1968 as the private, non-profit Durham Ambulance Corps in memory of Durham physician Dr. George G. McGregor.
Its snug headquarters at 47 College Road, behind Zais Hall, is mostly ambulance bays and is leased by the corps from UNH.
It is the primary emergency ambulance service for Durham, Lee, Madbury and UNH, and many of its volunteer EMTs are UNH students.

verdict: Snug ambulance-bay headquarters behind Zais Hall for the student-staffed volunteer EMS.
notes: The lease and address come from a 2003 article; current tenure not reconfirmed. A search snippet described the building as a low brick building that once housed lawnmowers, but I couldn't open the source (the UNH Today 2017 50th-anniversary piece redirected to the index), so it is left out. No construction date and no photos.
